abilities.name: Mire Pitchfork
abilities.text: Popelord turns a humble farm tool into a brutal answer to anything crawling out of the muck.

abilities.name: Compost Cape
abilities.text: Old grime, wet straw, and stubborn pride make him harder to read than any polished duelist.

abilities.name: Yard King
abilities.text: Caches, dumps, and broken work sites tend to reveal one more useful thing when Popelord starts digging.

abilities.name: Ripe Warning
abilities.text: When danger gets too close, everyone nearby knows it before the first blade is drawn.
